Supporting evidence: E005-E008, E017, E034-E039, E045, E048-E049, E052.","criticism_possible":"Criticism and institutional challenge were possible through independent media, civil society, courts, human-rights monitors, parliamentary processes, and international organizations; the notebook also records arrests, restrictions, shutdowns, and intimidation that constrained criticism. Supporting evidence: E003, E006-E007, E034, E037-E039, E043-E044, E052-E054.","duplicate_event_risk":"High. The notebook identifies overlap among E005-E011 and E034-E039 on security, disappearances, repression, and conflict; E015-E020 and E040-E049 on macro policy, floods, cash delivery, audits, and recovery; and E013-E014, E026-E033 on nuclear governance and assurances. These must be treated as distinct only where the claim and locator differ.","inherited_conditions_shocks_and_authority":"Sharif assumed office on 11 April 2022 after a no-confidence transition, with a slim coalition, substantial military influence, inherited fiscal and governance weaknesses, militant violence, global/external economic pressures, and catastrophic floods. Authority was formally civilian but practically shared across federal, provincial, military, donor, and UN institutions. Supporting evidence: E002-E003, E008, E011-E012, E015-E019, E027, E031, E040, E050-E056, E059.","languages_and_archives_searched":["English-language international, intergovernmental, NGO, official, specialist, media, and structured-data sources.","Urdu searches for nuclear command authority, export controls, cyber-security, biological risks, and Sharif-related themes were attempted during the 1B continuation.","No local-language archive search was completed for the broader chapters; several primary records, audits, court files, and local reporting remained unavailable."],"official_statistics_reliability":"Structured indicators and official program records are useful for measured country-year outcomes, expenditure, conflict, service, and delivery facts, but are not personal attribution evidence. Supporting evidence: E011-E012, E017, E021, E035, E042, E057.","safe_reporting_channels":"Courts, independent media, civil-society and human-rights organizations, parliamentary and official releases, international organizations, and specialist monitors provided reporting channels; the notebook documents shutdowns, legal pressure, military opacity, and constrained regions, so channel safety and completeness varied.
